contract.notes: Pins the route-derived RFC 9728 / RFC 6750 denial surface: a credential-free or invalid request returns 401 with the WWW-Authenticate challenge for the exact matched route's protected-resource metadata URL, a scope failure returns 403 insufficient_scope carrying the remediation scope set from the route scope map, and every other forbidden denial (for example an audience mismatch) advertises neither an error code nor a scope set. Loaded directly by the Go, TypeScript, and Python tests.

insufficient_scope.www_authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope", scope="<space-joined remediation scopes>", resource_metadata="<route protected-resource metadata URL>"

route_derived.note: The challenge's resource_metadata is the matched route's metadata URL, never a process-global value.

resource_indicator.rule: RFC 8707 resource is canonicalized and must exactly equal the route resource; any other value is refused
